description.encoder: GRU(input 4 -> hidden 128), reads the time-reversed sequence of [x, y, t/T, dt/T]; Linear(128 -> 32) gives mean and log-variance of z0
description.dynamics: dz/dt = f(z); tanh MLP with 2 hidden layers of width 64; autonomous (no explicit time input)
description.decoder: tanh MLP, 2 hidden layers of width 64, output 2 (x, y)
description.solver: rk4, fixed step 0.1, integrated from t = 0
